about: ReforgerZ prefab manifest: every prefab, slot, settings object, faction and loadout the mod needs. Read by the Workbench plugin 'ReforgerZ: Create prefabs' (scripts/WorkbenchGame/ReforgerZ/RZ_CreatePrefabsPlugin.c) and by tools/prefab_manifest.py, which checks it against the code and writes the tables in docs/WORKBENCH_SETUP.md. Vanilla paths and file names are suggestions: confirm them in Workbench.

world.step: Make a world as a sub-scene of the map (File > Load World the map, then File > New World > Sub-scene (of current world)); the repo has Worlds/RZ_Everon (the main world, on Eden) and Worlds/RZ_Arland (the small test world)
Place RZ_FactionManager.et (Prefabs/MP/Managers/Factions/: the four factions, the 15 hidden variants and SURV_OUTLAW below)
Place RZ_LoadoutManager.et (Prefabs/MP/Managers/Loadouts/: the 13 loadouts on SURV)

Place the map's AI world (vanilla Prefabs/AI/SCR_AIWorld_Arland.et, _Eden or _Cain) and set its Soldiers and BTRlike navmesh files (on Everon Navmesh_GM_Eden_Soldier.conf and GM_Eden_vehicles.nmn; on Arland worlds/GameMaster/Navmeshes/GM_Arland.nmn and GM_Arland_vehicles.nmn): without it no AI group gets members and there is no road network

Place the vanilla world managers every game-mode world has: Prefabs/World/Game/PerceptionManager.et (without it the game crashes in the first frame after the first AI spawns), Prefabs/Systems/Radio/RadioManager.et (radios), Prefabs/MP/ScriptedChatEntity.et (text chat) and Prefabs/World/Game/ItemPreviewManager.et (inventory previews)
Place RZ_GameMode.et in the world (one per world)

Keep RZ_GameMode.et's spawn logic on SCR_MenuSpawnLogic (the deploy menu) with Forced faction SURV, so the menu opens on the loadout picker: GameMode_Plain's SCR_AutoSpawnLogic picks a random faction from all of them
Save the world, and point a scenario (mission header) at it to play it
Optional: place marker entities (RZ_SettlementMarkerEntity and the others) to override automatic picks
